description: The chart illustrates the composition of two response types (“Ours” and “Standard”) broken down into three components: Context, Generated Response, and Other, shown as horizontal stacked bars. The category axis is vertical, listing “Ours” above “Standard,” and the value axis is horizontal with an implicit linear 0–100% scale representing percentage share (no explicit tick marks are shown). Each bar is segmented by color according to the legend: blue for Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other, with percentage labels printed on the segments. For “Ours,” the blue Context segment is labeled 60.6%, the green Other segment is labeled 7.7%, and the remaining orange Generated Response segment occupies the rest of the bar (approximately 31.7% by subtraction from 100%). For “Standard,” the blue Context segment is labeled 23.6%, the orange Generated Response segment is labeled 51.1%, and the green Other segment is labeled 25.3%. The bars are stacked left-to-right in the order Context, Generated Response, then Other, and there is no indication that categories are sorted by value; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the internal percentage annotations and the legend.
